en.title: Welcome our new partners in economics
en.summary: We are proud to announce the arrival of two new EDGE partners in economics.
en.image_alt: Welcome our new partners in economics
en.body:
We are proud to announce the arrival of two new EDGE partners in economics.

Our first partner is Regina Betz, Head of Center for Energy and the Environment (CEE) [@ZHAW](https://twitter.com/ZHAW), working in collaboration with Hannes Weigt from [@UniBasel\_en.](https://twitter.com/UniBasel_en)

Our second new partner is Philippe Thalmann, Professor of Economics and Director of the laboratory for environmental and urban economics

[@EPFL\_en](https://twitter.com/EPFL_en)

Welcome all !
